name: TurtleTracerLib
description: TurtleTracerLib: reading Turtle Tracer .turt files and triggering actions along a Pedro path.
appliesTo: TurtleTracerLib 3.0.0 or newer with Pedro Pathing 3. Put .turt files in `src/main/assets/AutoPaths` of the TeamCode module. The OpMode snippets assume the quickstart's `Constants` class.
